tools.description: Start a subagent in your run, with a brief for its first turn. It reports back with post_handoff. An empty harness takes yours. An empty model takes the first model the operator allowed on that harness; a harness and model the operator did not allow are refused, with the list of what is allowed. An empty effort takes yours.

harness.description: Optional. The agent CLI to run on.

plan_number.description: Optional. The plan this agent works on.

tools.name: spawn_agent

tools.description: Send text to one agent of your run. It reaches the agent as steering if it is working, or starts its next turn if it is idle.
tools.name: send_message

tools.description: List the agents of your run with their role, status and plan, so you can see who is working and who is done.
tools.name: list_agents

tools.description: Stop one subagent of your run. It is asked to finish its turn, then its session closes.
tools.name: stop_agent

tools.description: Send the operator a report. Decide every open question yourself and record each decision under decisions. Use kind progress for a note along the way. Use kind final once, when the work is finished, or only when an external factor you cannot fix stops all progress, such as no disk space, no quota or a host that is gone; then name the cause in the headline.

changed.description: What changed since the last report.

decisions.description: What you decided on your own, including every question that was open.

kind.description: progress for a note along the way; final for your last word.

tools.name: post_report
